question: In the five parallel 2-CEES adsorption experiments with FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs, what did the sample weigh after adsorption in the fourth?
rendered:
<document title="3D network carbon nanotube film supported FeCoNiCrMn high-entropy alloy nanoparticles for integrated adsorption and detoxification of sulfur mustard simulant">
=== page 1 ===
- At 25 °C and 50% RH, the composite delivers a high equilibrium adsorption capacity of 636 mg g^−1 for 2-chloroethyl ethyl sulfide (2-CEES) vapor, a sulfur mustard simulant.
- Table 1. Table 1 Comparison of weight before and after adsorption
Columns: Sample | Before | After | Adsorption (mg)
Sample | Before | After | Adsorption (mg)
First | 5 | 8.4 | 3.4
Second | 5 | 7.8 | 2.8
Third | 5 | 8.1 | 3.1
Fourth | 5 | 7.9 | 2.9
Fifth | 5 | 8.4 | 3.4

</document>

The sample weighed 7.9 grams after adsorption in the fourth experiment.
